== Description ==

Players still at the tables in the game room at Zu den Vier Winden in the early hours after Day 1 of the [[2024 World Championship]]. [[Robbie Hendon]] watches in his navy cap with a red brim. The other players are not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2024-worlds-bochum, Sean, posted with the words "3am vibes" on the night of 21–22 September 2024 (03:19 Bochum time on 22 September). Original file name: IMG_5313.jpg (3024×4032); Slack file id F07NGAPEDGS.
* '''Shared by:''' Sean (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 22 September 2024, about 03:00 local time.
* '''Identification:''' [[Robbie Hendon]]: navy cap with red brim and grey T-shirt, as #24 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]] and in [[:File:2024 World Championship Slack 22 September 09.jpg]].

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
